'''Noric Gestal''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Slaver/Legends|slaver]] around the time leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Gestal spent a great amount of time on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], searching for beautiful [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] females to sell to his customers. He was often at odds with [[Cheib'Kalla|Chieb'Kalla]], who employed a staff of beautiful females at the [[Fungus Pit]], where they were off-limits to slavers. Gestal's frustration boiled over into anger shortly after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], and he hatched a plot to steal as many of the females workers as he and his gang could. Entering a bar with twenty-three of his goons, their attempt was thwarted by a group of freelance agents who were on Ryloth in search of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Vhiin Thorla]]. In the fighting that ensued, Gestal himself was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and the other slavers were gassed into unconsciousness. They were later arrested and sent to prison.
